'''37''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Stationed aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Inquisitor (Star Destroyer)|''Inquisitor'']], he was part of a boarding party under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Taggert]] that boarded the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Seldom Different]]''.<ref name="OOTC" />
